_comment: V2 Phase 1B (BL-023, docs/v2/10-BACKLOG.md). The original 120 templates were generated directly from live data/configuration/sources.json on 2026-08-14; three verified recurring spoken-word Sources were registered in both files on 2026-08-15, one more on 2026-08-16, and seven more (configuration-only archive/source-discovery onboarding: source-the-packer-podcast, source-fresh-takes-on-tech-podcast, source-produce-buzzers-podcast, source-global-fresh-series-podcast, source-fresh-cred-podcast, source-lubera-edibles-podcast, source-blueberries-tv-youtube) on 2026-08-16. collector_type separates the platform-level Collector mechanism (rss, keyword_search -- both automatable per docs/v2/02-TARGET-ARCHITECTURE.md Section 7) from reference_manual (a real, valuable source with no automated collection today -- ARCHITECTURE.md: 'Reference sources... aren't polled, mark them checked manually'). All 132 live sources are represented and structurally suitable for templating; none were excluded. Deliberately NOT copied from the live registry: linked_competitor_ids, last_checked_at, last_status, validated_count, purged_count, created_at -- these are this specific workspace's operational history, not reusable template content, same reasoning as strategic-question-templates.json omitting evidence_ids/fact_ids. This task does not implement or refactor collector execution code, and does not modify check_source() or source polling behavior -- these are declarative templates only, for a future Collector framework to consume.

collector_templates.label: Michigan State University Blueberry Breeding Program
collector_templates.notes: Public breeding program of record for 'Draper', 'Aurora', 'Liberty' and 'Osorno' -- the origin point for genetics Hortifrut licenses commercially; tracks new MSU releases before they reach commercial licensees.

collector_templates.label: Berry Blue, LLC
collector_templates.notes: Hortifrut/Michigan Blueberry Growers breeding joint venture behind 'Prelude', 'Daybreak', 'Stellar', 'Candycrunch' and 'Apolo' -- direct source for licensing terms and new variety announcements from one of the largest blueberry genetics platforms.

collector_templates.label: Hortifrut Genetica (PMG)
collector_templates.notes: Hortifrut's own global genetic improvement program page -- primary source for the company's own account of its breeding activity, useful for cross-checking against third-party reporting on the same claims.

collector_templates.label: Fall Creek Farm & Nursery
collector_templates.notes: Global blueberry nursery and genetics licensor behind the SEKOYA platform; catalogue and press releases are the fastest way to see new variety commercialization before independent coverage appears.

collector_templates.label: Spanish Royal Berry Program
collector_templates.notes: Licensor of record for 'Rocio' and 'Corona', which Hortifrut licenses exclusively for the Americas -- tracks the licensing terms and territory scope at the source rather than through a licensee's paraphrase.

collector_templates.label: Global Plant Genetics (GPG)
collector_templates.notes: Commercial IP/licensing platform spanning blueberry, raspberry, blackberry and strawberry genetics -- a cross-berry licensing signal that most single-berry sources can't provide.

collector_templates.label: University of Georgia Blueberry Breeding Program
collector_templates.query_or_url: University of Georgia Blueberry Breeding Program
collector_templates.notes: Public southern highbush breeding program independent of the commercial licensors -- a check on whether a given trait or release claim originates from public or proprietary genetics.

collector_templates.label: University of Florida Blueberry Breeding Program
collector_templates.notes: Public breeding program for low-chill southern highbush cultivars adapted to Florida; releases are licensed through Florida Foundation Seed Producers, so this is the upstream source for FFSP's catalogue.

collector_templates.label: Plant & Food Research (New Zealand) Blueberry Genetics
collector_templates.notes: Southern Hemisphere public breeding program -- coverage most Northern-Hemisphere-focused sources miss entirely, relevant to counter-seasonal supply and Oceania variety licensing.

collector_templates.label: BC Berry Genetics
collector_templates.notes: British Columbia-based blueberry genetics source; regional counterpoint to the larger US/Chile-centered licensors.

collector_templates.label: Pacific Berry Breeding (PBB)
collector_templates.notes: Hortifrut/Naturipe joint venture for raspberry and blackberry genetics based in Watsonville, CA -- the raspberry/blackberry counterpart to Berry Blue's blueberry role, same two-parent ownership structure worth tracking for consistency.

collector_templates.label: NIAB EMR (East Malling Research)
collector_templates.notes: UK public raspberry breeding institution; primary source for European raspberry genetics independent of the Total Berry/Meiosis commercial licensing chain.

collector_templates.label: James Hutton Institute
collector_templates.notes: Scottish raspberry and blackberry breeding program that licenses its own IP -- both the origin source and a licensor, useful for tracking new releases before Meiosis commercializes them.

collector_templates.label: Meiosis Ltd
collector_templates.notes: Commercializes James Hutton Institute varieties -- the licensing/commercial layer on top of Hutton's public breeding output; tracks which varieties actually reach growers and on what terms.

collector_templates.label: Total Berry
collector_templates.notes: Spain-based, Meiosis-affiliated raspberry/blackberry genetics distributor -- the Iberian commercialization point for Hutton-derived varieties.

collector_templates.label: UC Davis Strawberry Breeding & Research Program
collector_templates.notes: 30+ patented varieties licensed via Fresa Fortaleza and Global Plant Genetics -- the single most consequential public strawberry breeding program by commercial reach; new releases here reshape licensing terms industry-wide.

collector_templates.label: University of Florida Strawberry Breeding Program
collector_templates.query_or_url: University of Florida Strawberry Breeding Program
collector_templates.notes: Whitaker/Peres/Lee program developing low-chill southern strawberry cultivars -- the Florida counterpart to UC Davis, relevant for winter/early-season supply.

collector_templates.label: Plant Sciences Inc.
collector_templates.notes: California commercial strawberry genetics and nursery operation -- a private-sector counterweight to the UC Davis public program, useful for spotting where proprietary genetics are displacing public varieties.

collector_templates.label: Driscoll's Proprietary Strawberry Breeding Program
collector_templates.notes: Driscoll's closed-genetics strawberry program -- the largest fully proprietary strawberry breeding effort; unlike UC Davis or UF, its releases never reach competitors, so tracking it is about competitive positioning, not licensing.

collector_templates.label: California Giant Berry Farms Breeding Partnerships
collector_templates.query_or_url: California Giant Berry Farms Breeding Partnerships
collector_templates.notes: Grower-marketer with its own breeding partnerships across three berries -- a demand-side signal for which genetics are actually being planted at scale, not just announced.

collector_templates.label: Fresa Fortaleza
collector_templates.notes: Commercialization partner for UC Davis strawberry varieties -- the licensing/distribution layer that determines which growers actually get access to new UC releases and on what terms.

collector_templates.label: Spanish Strawberry Breeding Programs (Planasa, FNM/Huelva)
collector_templates.notes: Planasa and Fresas Nuevos Materiales cover the Huelva region, the dominant European strawberry production area -- the European counterpart to the US public/private breeding split.

collector_templates.label: University of Arkansas Fruit Breeding Program
collector_templates.notes: World's largest public blackberry program (Worthington/Clark), 43+ varieties released including the Prime-Ark(R) and Sweet-Ark(TM) series -- the single most important blackberry genetics source globally; almost every commercial blackberry variety traces back here.

collector_templates.label: EMCO CAL
collector_templates.notes: International variety development and trial partner for University of Arkansas blackberry germplasm -- tracks which Arkansas selections are actually being trialed and commercialized outside the US.

collector_templates.label: Driscoll's Proprietary Blackberry Breeding
collector_templates.notes: Driscoll's closed blackberry genetics program -- the proprietary counterpart to the Arkansas public program, same competitive-positioning rationale as its strawberry program.

collector_templates.label: Driscoll's
collector_templates.notes: Largest global berry marketer across all four berries with closed proprietary genetics on each -- the single most important company to monitor for competitive positioning across the whole category.

collector_templates.label: Naturipe Farms/Berries
collector_templates.notes: US grower-marketer cooperative across all four berries, co-owner of Pacific Berry Breeding -- tracks demand-side and genetics-access signals from a Driscoll's competitor of comparable scale.

collector_templates.label: Hortifrut S.A.
collector_templates.notes: Chile-based global blueberry leader and Berry Blue/Atlantic Blue genetics owner -- already the most evidence-rich entity in this dataset; investor filings and press releases are the highest-signal primary source for its own M&A and genetics activity.

collector_templates.label: California Giant Berry Farms
collector_templates.notes: Three-berry grower-marketer, listed separately here for its marketing/demand-side reporting distinct from its breeding partnerships entry above.

collector_templates.label: SunnyRidge Farm
collector_templates.notes: Blueberry-focused grower-marketer with Southern Hemisphere counter-season sourcing -- a mid-size competitor signal distinct from the Hortifrut/Driscoll's/Naturipe majors.

collector_templates.label: Munger Farms
collector_templates.notes: California/Chile blueberry grower -- tracks a specific US-Chile vertically integrated supply chain.

collector_templates.label: Agrovision / Camposol
collector_templates.notes: Peru-based blueberry grower (rebranded Fruitist in 2025) diversifying into avocado -- already evidence-rich in this dataset for its founding-year discrepancy and Fruitist rebrand; ongoing filings would resolve the open questions already on record.

collector_templates.label: Superfrost / Frusan
collector_templates.notes: Chilean export-side operator -- a logistics/export-volume signal distinct from the grower-genetics sources above.

collector_templates.label: BerryWorld Group
collector_templates.notes: UK/global marketing alliance already on record in this dataset for its Mountain Blue-derived retail brand family (BerryWorld Eureka, Twilight, etc.) -- the primary source for how Mountain Blue genetics get rebranded at retail.

collector_templates.label: Costa Group
collector_templates.notes: Australian berry grower and owner of the BluGenix breeding platform -- already evidence-rich in this dataset (2024 consortium takeover, delisting); ongoing coverage would track the post-takeover ownership structure.

collector_templates.label: Family Tree Farms
collector_templates.notes: California stone fruit grower diversifying into berries -- a new-entrant signal worth tracking for how outside growers enter the category.

collector_templates.label: Dandong Region Strawberry Cooperatives (China)
collector_templates.notes: Domestic Chinese strawberry production cluster -- one of the only entries in this list covering Chinese strawberry supply directly rather than through export/import statistics.

collector_templates.label: VidaFresh / T&G Global
collector_templates.notes: New Zealand grower-marketer -- Southern Hemisphere, counter-season supply signal across multiple berries.

collector_templates.label: International Blueberry Organization (IBO)
collector_templates.notes: Represents 90%+ of world blueberry production and publishes the annual Global State of the Blueberry Industry report -- the single highest-authority global blueberry production and acreage dataset available.

collector_templates.label: U.S. Highbush Blueberry Council (USHBC)
collector_templates.notes: US blueberry demand promotion body with its own business intelligence dashboards -- a demand-side and consumption-trend signal that supply-side sources (breeders, growers) don't provide.

collector_templates.label: North American Blueberry Council (NABC)
collector_templates.notes: US/Canada blueberry industry advocacy body -- policy and trade-position signal distinct from USHBC's consumption focus.

collector_templates.label: California Strawberry Commission
collector_templates.notes: California produces the large majority of US strawberries; this commission's data is the closest thing to a national US strawberry acreage/volume signal.

collector_templates.label: Florida Strawberry Growers Association
collector_templates.notes: Represents the winter-season US strawberry supply that complements California's, relevant to seasonal supply-gap analysis.

collector_templates.label: North American Raspberry & Blackberry Association (NARBA)
collector_templates.notes: The only dedicated North American trade body covering both raspberry and blackberry -- fills a gap left by the blueberry- and strawberry-focused associations above.

collector_templates.label: European Fruit Growers Associations (Raspberry)
collector_templates.notes: European raspberry grower advocacy -- regional counterpart to NARBA; coverage should be spot-checked for which specific national body is most active before relying on it.

collector_templates.label: Comite de Arandanos de Chile (Chilean Blueberry Committee)
collector_templates.query_or_url: Comite de Arandanos de Chile (Chilean Blueberry Committee)
collector_templates.notes: Chile is a top-three global blueberry exporter; this committee is the primary domestic industry voice, distinct from ProChile's trade-promotion angle.

collector_templates.label: ProChile / ProArandanos
collector_templates.notes: Chilean state trade-promotion body for blueberry exports -- export-volume and market-access signal complementing the Blueberry Committee's production-side data.

collector_templates.label: Asociacion de Productores de Arandanos (Proarandanos Peru)
collector_templates.query_or_url: Asociacion de Productores de Arandanos (Proarandanos Peru)
collector_templates.notes: Already a cited source in this dataset for Peruvian export-volume-by-variety figures (SEKOYA Pop, Eureka); ongoing monitoring would keep those season-by-season figures current.

collector_templates.label: China Fruit Marketing Association (Berry Subcommittee)
collector_templates.notes: One of the only association-level sources for the Chinese domestic berry market, relevant to both a major producer (blueberry) and consumer (all four) market.

collector_templates.label: Freshfel Europe
collector_templates.notes: EU-wide fresh produce trade body covering berry trade across the whole bloc -- fills the gap between country-specific European sources.

collector_templates.label: Produce for Better Health Foundation
collector_templates.notes: Consumption/health research partner to IBO's Global State report -- a demand-side, health-driven consumption signal distinct from the production-focused association data elsewhere on this list.

collector_templates.label: USDA NASS
collector_templates.notes: Noncitrus Fruits and Nuts Annual Summary and Census of Agriculture specialty crop tables -- the authoritative US acreage, yield and value dataset across all four berries; nothing else in this list has the same statistical rigor for US production.

collector_templates.label: USDA AMS
collector_templates.notes: Fruit and Vegetable Market News and specialty crop reports -- pricing and market-movement data at a finer grain than NASS's annual census.

collector_templates.label: USDA RMA
collector_templates.notes: Crop insurance specialty crop reports double as a market-penetration proxy -- which regions/growers are insuring berry acreage, an indirect signal NASS doesn't provide directly.

collector_templates.label: USDA FAS (GAIN Reports)
collector_templates.notes: Foreign Agricultural Service reports on berry production in Mexico, Peru, Chile, Morocco and China -- the US government's own foreign-production intelligence, useful for cross-checking against each country's own trade association figures.

collector_templates.label: USDA APHIS
collector_templates.notes: Phytosanitary and import regulations affecting berry trade -- a regulatory-exposure signal for any variety or shipment dependent on import access.

collector_templates.label: European Commission DG AGRI (EU CMO / Fruit Sector Market Observatory)
collector_templates.query_or_url: European Commission DG AGRI (EU CMO / Fruit Sector Market Observatory)
collector_templates.notes: EU-wide fruit sector market observatory -- the European counterpart to USDA NASS/AMS, filling the largest gap in this list's regulatory/statistical coverage.

collector_templates.label: China National Bureau of Statistics / MOA
collector_templates.query_or_url: China National Bureau of Statistics / MOA
collector_templates.notes: Official Chinese fruit production data -- pairs with the China Fruit Marketing Association's industry-level view for a fuller picture of the Chinese market.

collector_templates.label: SENASA (Peru)
collector_templates.notes: Peruvian phytosanitary regulator -- import/export access signal for a top blueberry exporting country.

collector_templates.label: SAG (Chile)
collector_templates.notes: Chilean phytosanitary regulator (Servicio Agricola y Ganadero) -- same role as SENASA for Chile, the largest Southern Hemisphere blueberry exporter.

collector_templates.label: SENASICA (Mexico)
collector_templates.notes: Mexican phytosanitary regulator -- covers a major supplier to the US market across multiple berries, distinct from USDA APHIS's importer-side view.

collector_templates.label: U.S. Plant Variety Protection Office / USPTO
collector_templates.notes: Plant patents on berry cultivars -- already the backbone of the identity/ownership data in this dataset (the USPP patent records); the primary source of record for variety ownership disputes.

collector_templates.label: UPOV
collector_templates.notes: International Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants -- the global plant variety rights database underlying every country-specific PBR record already in this dataset (e.g. the Canadian CFIA records).

collector_templates.label: UC Davis Department of Plant Sciences / Foundation Plant Services
collector_templates.notes: Foundation Plant Services is the certified-nursery-stock source underlying the UC Davis strawberry program's actual commercial rollout, distinct from the breeding program entry above.

collector_templates.label: University of Arkansas Fruit Research Station, Clarksville
collector_templates.query_or_url: University of Arkansas Fruit Research Station, Clarksville
collector_templates.notes: Field-trial site already cited in this dataset for a 2024 20-variety blueberry trial with measured Brix/pH/acidity data -- the primary source for independently measured (not company-claimed) variety performance data.

collector_templates.label: University of Florida IFAS
collector_templates.notes: Extension literature and cultivar performance data already cited extensively in this dataset (Sentinel, Colossus, Optimus firmness/yield measurements) -- the primary source of independently measured UF variety performance.

collector_templates.label: Michigan State University Extension (Blueberry)
collector_templates.notes: Extension-side counterpart to the MSU breeding program entry -- grower-facing guidance and cultivar recommendations rather than breeding announcements.

collector_templates.label: Plant & Food Research (New Zealand)
collector_templates.notes: Listed separately from the breeding-program entry above for its wider research-publication output beyond blueberry variety releases specifically.

collector_templates.label: International Society for Horticultural Science (ISHS)
collector_templates.notes: Acta Horticulturae proceedings already cited in this dataset for the University of Arkansas blackberry program's own 30-year retrospective -- the primary peer-reviewed venue for berry breeding program history and methodology across all four berries.

collector_templates.label: USDA Agricultural Research Service (ARS)
collector_templates.notes: Berry germplasm repositories -- the genetic-diversity source underlying public breeding programs' raw material, one step upstream of the breeding programs themselves.

collector_templates.label: Fruit Growers News
collector_templates.notes: US grower-facing trade press across all four berries -- practical/operational signal (planting, harvest, labor) distinct from the deal/M&A focus of the outlets below.

collector_templates.label: Produce Blue Book / Blue Book Services
collector_templates.query_or_url: Produce Blue Book / Blue Book Services
collector_templates.notes: Produce industry credit and company-reference database with news coverage -- useful for verifying counterparty legitimacy alongside straight news signal.

collector_templates.label: The Packer
collector_templates.notes: Long-running US produce industry trade press -- broad-coverage baseline for North American berry news.

collector_templates.label: Fresh Fruit Portal
collector_templates.notes: Explicitly weighted High priority per this list's own coverage-gap note: fastest-moving deal, M&A and variety-launch signal for Latin America-focused berry news, an area annual reports and government statistics cover too slowly. Confirmed 2026-08-06 to have a real, berry-scoped RSS feed (/tag/berries/feed/) with genuine article excerpts, not just repeated headlines -- converted from reference to a live-polled rss source.

collector_templates.label: Fresh Plaza
collector_templates.notes: Explicitly weighted High priority per this list's own coverage-gap note: global fresh produce news with strong berry coverage, fills the same fast-moving-deal gap as Fresh Fruit Portal but with broader geographic scope.

collector_templates.label: Hortidaily
collector_templates.notes: Sister publication to Fresh Plaza with a horticulture/greenhouse production lens -- relevant to protected-cropping berry production specifically.

collector_templates.label: Growing Produce
collector_templates.notes: US grower-facing coverage overlapping with Fruit Growers News -- kept as a separate source for redundancy on operational/production signal.

collector_templates.label: Berry World News (Industry Newsletter Aggregators)
collector_templates.notes: Aggregator-style coverage -- useful as a discovery layer for stories this list's other, more targeted sources might miss.

collector_templates.label: AndNowUKnow
collector_templates.notes: Explicitly weighted High priority per this list's own coverage-gap note: produce industry press releases carried faster than most trade press picks them up, a leading indicator for deal/executive-move announcements.

collector_templates.label: Produce Report
collector_templates.notes: Explicitly weighted High priority per this list's own coverage-gap note: the primary English-language source for China-focused fresh produce news, already cited in this dataset for SEKOYA's Chinese market expansion statement.

collector_templates.label: EastFruit
collector_templates.notes: Eastern Europe / Central Asia produce news -- geographic coverage no other source on this list provides.

collector_templates.label: IBO Global State of the Blueberry Industry Report
collector_templates.query_or_url: IBO Global State of the Blueberry Industry Report
collector_templates.notes: Annual flagship report -- listed separately from the IBO association entry above because this is specifically the report deliverable, the single most-cited external data point for global blueberry acreage and volume comparisons.

collector_templates.label: Rabobank Fresh Produce / Berry Sector Reports
collector_templates.query_or_url: Rabobank Fresh Produce / Berry Sector Reports
collector_templates.notes: Financial-sector analysis of berry supply/demand fundamentals -- an investment/capital-flows lens distinct from the production-statistics focus of the government and association sources.

collector_templates.label: Tridge
collector_templates.notes: Global agri-commodity trade data platform -- cross-border trade-flow visibility complementing country-specific export association data.

collector_templates.label: Mintec / Expana Berry Price Benchmarking
collector_templates.notes: Price benchmarking already partially represented in this dataset via the Agronometrics Peruvian varietal price index -- this is the broader, cross-market pricing data source that would extend that kind of analysis beyond Peru.

collector_templates.label: Euromonitor / Mordor Intelligence Berry Market Sizing Reports
collector_templates.query_or_url: Euromonitor / Mordor Intelligence Berry Market Sizing Reports
collector_templates.notes: Market-sizing and forecast reports -- a longer-horizon, category-growth lens distinct from the season-by-season trade data elsewhere on this list.

collector_templates.label: Nielsen/Circana Retail Scan Data
collector_templates.notes: Retail scan data for berry category sales -- the only true point-of-sale demand signal on this entire list; every other source is supply-side or trade-side.

collector_templates.label: Blueberry breeding program
collector_templates.notes: Catches new-program announcements and breeding-program personnel/funding news outside the named institutional sources above.

collector_templates.label: Raspberry variety license
collector_templates.notes: Catches licensing-deal announcements for raspberry genetics outside the named Hutton/Meiosis/Total Berry sources.

collector_templates.label: Strawberry cultivar patent
collector_templates.notes: Catches new strawberry plant patent filings/grants as they're reported, ahead of formal USPTO record availability.

collector_templates.label: Blackberry primocane variety
collector_templates.notes: Primocane-fruiting is the key trait axis in blackberry breeding right now; this catches trait-specific announcements outside the Arkansas program's own channels.

collector_templates.label: Berry genetics company
collector_templates.notes: Cross-berry catch-all for genetics-company M&A that a single-berry keyword would miss.

collector_templates.label: Plant variety protection berry
collector_templates.notes: Catches PBR/plant-patent news across all four berries in one query, ahead of the country-specific registries in this list being updated.

collector_templates.label: Berry royalty license agreement
collector_templates.notes: Catches licensing-term disclosures (royalty rates, exclusivity terms) that rarely appear in a company's own press releases.

collector_templates.label: Exclusive variety license berry
collector_templates.notes: Catches new exclusive-licensing-territory announcements, the same category of claim already on record for Hortifrut's Rocio/Corona and Draper/Aurora licenses.

collector_templates.label: Company acquisition berry
collector_templates.notes: Broad M&A catch-all across the whole category.

collector_templates.label: Berry joint venture genetics
collector_templates.notes: Catches new joint-venture formations like Berry Blue and Pacific Berry Breeding before they're covered by the named trade press.

collector_templates.label: Berry nursery partnership
collector_templates.notes: Catches nursery-level partnership announcements distinct from genetics-licensing deals specifically.

collector_templates.label: Berry industry investment
collector_templates.notes: Broad capital-flows catch-all, complements the Rabobank market-research entry above with real-time deal announcements.

collector_templates.label: Berry export volume
collector_templates.notes: Catches export-volume reporting outside the fixed reporting calendar of the named trade associations.

collector_templates.label: Berry harvest forecast
collector_templates.notes: Forward-looking supply signal ahead of actual harvest/export data being reported.

collector_templates.label: Berry acreage expansion
collector_templates.notes: Catches new-planting announcements well ahead of the next annual acreage census from USDA NASS or equivalent bodies.

collector_templates.label: Phytosanitary berry import restriction
collector_templates.notes: Catches new trade-restriction announcements faster than the regulatory agencies' own publication cycles.

collector_templates.label: MRL berry regulation
collector_templates.notes: Maximum residue limit changes directly affect market access; this is a faster signal than waiting for APHIS/DG AGRI updates.

collector_templates.label: USDA GAIN report berry
collector_templates.notes: Catches new GAIN report releases as they're published, complementing the USDA FAS entry above.

collector_templates.label: Berry tariff
collector_templates.notes: Trade-policy signal directly affecting cross-border berry pricing and sourcing decisions.

collector_templates.label: Berry plant patent granted
collector_templates.notes: Catches newly granted patents as reported, ahead of them appearing in the USPTO/PVP registry searches this dataset already relies on.

collector_templates.label: UPOV berry variety registration
collector_templates.notes: Catches new UPOV registrations as reported, complementing the UPOV database entry above.

collector_templates.label: Peru blueberry export
collector_templates.notes: Peru is a top global blueberry exporter and already has extensive coverage in this dataset (Proarandanos volume-by-variety data); this keeps that season-by-season picture current.

collector_templates.label: Chile blueberry season
collector_templates.notes: Chile is the largest Southern Hemisphere blueberry exporter; season-timing news is a leading indicator for counter-season US/EU supply.

collector_templates.label: Mexico berry production
collector_templates.notes: Mexico is a major supplier across multiple berries to the US market; catches production news outside SENASICA's regulatory-only coverage.

collector_templates.label: Morocco berry exports
collector_templates.notes: Morocco is a growing blueberry/raspberry exporter already referenced in this dataset via Costa's African Blue operation; catches broader Moroccan sector news beyond that one company.

collector_templates.label: China strawberry market
collector_templates.notes: China is a major strawberry producer and consumer; catches domestic market news the Dandong cooperative entry alone wouldn't surface.

collector_templates.label: Spain Huelva strawberry
collector_templates.notes: Huelva is the dominant European strawberry production region, already referenced via Planasa/FNM; catches broader regional news beyond those two companies.

collector_templates.label: Netherlands berry greenhouse
collector_templates.notes: Dutch protected-cropping berry production is a distinct supply category from open-field production covered elsewhere on this list.

collector_templates.label: South Africa blueberry IBO summit
collector_templates.notes: South Africa is a growing blueberry exporter and past IBO summit host; catches conference-driven announcements that cluster around industry events.

collector_templates.label: Berry consumption trend
collector_templates.notes: Consumer-demand signal complementing USHBC and Nielsen/Circana's more structured demand data.

collector_templates.label: Berry retail sales data
collector_templates.notes: Catches retail sales reporting outside Nielsen/Circana's formal data releases.

collector_templates.label: Berry health research
collector_templates.notes: Health-research findings are a recurring driver of demand spikes (as with the Produce for Better Health Foundation partnership); catches new studies as they're published.

collector_templates.label: Berry category growth
collector_templates.notes: Broad category-level growth signal complementing the narrower Euromonitor/Mordor market-sizing reports.

collector_templates.label: Lucentlands Podcast
collector_templates.notes: Long-form agricultural interviews with executives, growers, associations, researchers and industry specialists provide context on Southern African production, markets, technology and fresh-produce strategy.

collector_templates.label: The Business of Blueberries (USHBC / NABC)
collector_templates.notes: USHBC/NABC's weekly industry podcast covers blueberry production, markets, research, technology, crop progress, weather, exports and international supply through interviews and crop reports.

collector_templates.label: Redagrícola / Redagrícola On The Road
collector_templates.notes: First-party field and executive coverage from Latin American farms and agribusinesses surfaces grower operations, varietal renewal, packing, technology, investment and market conditions, especially in Peru and Chile.

collector_templates.label: University of Arkansas System Division of Agriculture (YouTube)
collector_templates.notes: First-party video channel of the University of Arkansas System Division of Agriculture, carrying the annual Blackberry Field Day recap and AAES 'Behind the Discovery' researcher features (e.g. Amanda McWhirt's blackberry production/trellising work) interleaved with the Division's much broader general Extension outreach content.

collector_templates.label: Comité de Arándanos de Chile (YouTube)
collector_templates.notes: First-party YouTube channel of the Comité de Arándanos de Chile -- a small (8-video) 2014-2015 catalogue of first-party harvest/packing training material. Onboarded as this feature's real, live Tier-3 (no-usable-captions) proof source; see feature/youtube-tier3-whisper-proof's report.

collector_templates.label: The Packer Podcast
collector_templates.notes: PMG/Farm Journal's weekly fresh produce industry podcast -- interviews with growers, marketers, buyers and supply-chain executives across the whole produce category, with recurring blueberry-specific coverage (e.g. 'Kevin Hamilton on Driving Desire when Marketing Blueberries'). A spoken-word companion to this dataset's existing prose 'The Packer' trade-press Source (source-20260806173428-47f6-the-packer-72), not a replacement for it -- same publisher, distinct channel/medium, mirroring how source-business-of-blueberries-podcast sits alongside the existing USHBC prose Source.

collector_templates.label: Fresh Takes on Tech (International Fresh Produce Association)
collector_templates.notes: International Fresh Produce Association's technology-focused podcast covering the intersection of tech and the fresh produce/floral supply chain -- recurring berry-specific coverage confirmed directly in episode descriptions (blueberries, strawberries and blackberries all present across the current 132-episode feed), giving a technology-adoption angle (traceability, automation, ag-tech) this dataset otherwise lacks for berries specifically.

collector_templates.label: Produce Buzzers
collector_templates.notes: Consumer-facing fresh produce podcast ('part informative radio show, part trivia game show') hosted by Theresa Nolan, Edwin Stepp, Rick Stepp and Cynthia Benedetto -- the densest confirmed berry coverage of any candidate in this onboarding batch (blueberry/strawberry/raspberry/blackberry keyword hits all present, strawberry mentioned 18+ times across the current feed), a consumer-demand-signal complement to this dataset's mostly trade/supply-side sources.

collector_templates.label: Global Fresh Series (The Produce Industry Network)
collector_templates.notes: The Produce Industry Network's global fresh produce podcast hosted by Juanita Gaglio -- explicit, repeated blueberry-specific episode coverage confirmed directly in the feed ('From Bananas to Blueberries: Fresh Produce Under Threat and Innovation', 'Fresh Perspectives: Avocados, Tomatoes, and Blueberries from Chile to the World', "Berry Benefits: Unveiling the Wild Blueberry's Global Appeal"), including explicit Chilean/Southern Hemisphere blueberry supply-chain content.

collector_templates.label: The Fresh CrEd
collector_templates.notes: Ed Bertaud's fresh produce industry podcast covering freight, pricing pressure, sourcing, retail dynamics and supply-chain shifts from the operator/buyer/grower perspective -- a current, high-cadence show (100 episodes, latest published 2026-08-12) with confirmed strawberry-relevant content, adding operational/logistics texture this dataset's mostly institutional/association sources don't provide.

collector_templates.label: Lubera Edibles Gardeners Radio
collector_templates.notes: Lubera Edibles (Swiss fruit-plant breeder/nursery)'s own professional podcast, aimed at production gardeners, final-sales gardeners and green-industry journalists -- direct first-party coverage of the company's own berry breeding and young-plant ('Treelings(R)') genetics, with confirmed dedicated episodes on strawberries ('The Lubera(R) strawberry families', container production), blueberries (container production) and raspberries (cultivation, 'the new raspberry families') -- the European nursery/genetics counterpart to Fall Creek Farm & Nursery's entry in this dataset (source-20260806173428-5498-fall-creek-farm-nursery-3).

collector_templates.label: Blueberries TV (Blueberries Consulting)
collector_templates.notes: Official YouTube channel of Blueberries Consulting, the independent, third-party global blueberry-industry consultancy (20+ years, 40+ International Blueberries Seminar editions across Peru, Chile, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Spain, Morocco and China) -- first-party video coverage of seminar sessions, sponsor/exhibitor interviews (e.g. Fall Creek, Projar, Water Partners) and Southern Hemisphere/Mediterranean blueberry supply-chain content. Distinct from this dataset's existing source-20260806173428-6938-international-blueberry-organization-ibo-38 (the IBO itself, a producer-representation trade body) and from source-comite-de-arandanos-de-chile-youtube (Chile's national blueberry committee) -- Blueberries Consulting is a private media/consulting company, not a producer or government body, confirmed via this branch's own prior-session research (see this branch's earlier archive-adapter research commit) as the real, verified producer of the seminar video content originally suspected to belong to the IBO directly.

collector_templates.label: Growing Produce - Berries
collector_templates.notes: Berry-scoped category feed from a major US grower-trade publisher (Meister Media), covering production practices, variety trials, and grower-facing agronomy news not always covered by the Latin-America-weighted Fresh Fruit Portal feed. Confirmed live 2026-08-19 (200, application/rss+xml), berry-tagged content confirmed on inspection.
